description.value: Safari Beach Resort is a lakefront condominium resort on the shores of Lake Osoyoos — the warmest lake in Canada — in the sunny South Okanagan. The resort features over 400 feet of private sandy beach, two outdoor pools, and fully furnished condo units with private decks overlooking the lake, surrounding vineyards, and mountains. Shops, restaurants, golf courses, a water park, and wineries are all within walking distance or a short ride, making it a practical and scenic stop for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and active (copyright 2026), confirming the resort is open. The amenities page explicitly lists 'guest laundry', 'free wireless internet', and an 'ice and snack vending machine'; the front page states 'conveniently located shops and restaurants are within walking distance'. No bike-specific facilities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site. OSM email (safari.r@telus.net) differs from the website email (safari@safaribeachresort.com), and the website provides a fuller address with city and postal code than the OSM record.
concerns: Email mismatch: OSM lists safari.r@telus.net but the website shows safari@safaribeachresort.com — the OSM email may be outdated.
OSM address omits city and postal code; website provides full address as 5815 Oleander Drive, Osoyoos, BC V0H1V1 — used the website value.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active lakefront resort in Osoyoos BC with a live website, confirmed contact details, and multiple listed amenities useful to touring cyclists.
